# A user component with an empty body is dead code, so the optimizer drops the
# declaration while the call site's node survives pointing at it. android used
# to fall through to the same generic emitter the stdlib components used, which
# picked a prop off the node and drew it as text: `blank(value="hello")`
# rendered `Text("hello")` for a component whose body says to draw nothing.
# There is no generic emitter any more, and an eliminated user component draws
# what its body said: nothing — not a placeholder either.

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=out app.sngl

! grep 'hello' out/MainScreen.kt
! grep 'unknown' out/MainScreen.kt

# A component that does have a body still renders it.
grep 'Text\(text = "x", modifier = Modifier\)' out/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

component blank(value string) {
}

component shown(caption string) {
    vbox {
        text(value=caption)
    }
}

component main {
    blank(value="hello")
    shown(caption="x")
}
